summary: Bobby Stringer, missing in the Phantom Canyon area since Feb. 21; remains found April 19 by BLM rangers conducting raptor counts and identified April 26 via autopsy
location: Phantom Canyon, near mile marker 10 on Fremont County Road 67
responding_agency: Fremont County Search and Rescue; Fremont County Sheriff's Office; Fremont County Coroner's Office
notes: Recovery operation 2022-04-19; remains identified as Bobby Stringer after April 26 autopsy. Year pinned from the Mountain Mail 'reported Wednesday' = 2022-04-27. Date = recovery date per the missing-person-found-dead convention (ids 1308/2593/2712).
